thread.title: Special Participation A: GPT-Oss on HW5
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph/><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/36Ibqekm0cq7clyfZo5xJMtP" filename="SpecialParticipationA-GPTOssHW5.pdf"/><paragraph>For this special participation, I used gpt-oss-120b (Reasoning = High) to solve all non-coding analytical parts of HW5 (Q1–Q4).<break/>The model was tested on symbolic derivations and conceptual reasoning without code execution.</paragraph><list style="unordered"><list-item><paragraph>Accuracy: 9 / 11 one-shot (82 %), 2 / 11 minor-nudge (18 %)</paragraph></list-item><list-item><paragraph>Main errors: one ASCII matrix mis-parse and one BatchNorm vs LayerNorm confusion</paragraph></list-item><list-item><paragraph>No hallucinations: all final answers matched the official HW5 solution key</paragraph></list-item><list-item><paragraph>Takeaway: once prompts were clearly formatted in LaTeX, the model produced correct and interpretable derivations, showing reliable analytical reasoning but high sensitivity to input structure.</paragraph></list-item><list-item><paragraph>Bit slow(90-180 seconds)</paragraph></list-item></list><paragraph>(Logs and annotations are attached in the full PDF report.)</paragraph></document>
thread.document:
For this special participation, I used gpt-oss-120b (Reasoning = High) to solve all non-coding analytical parts of HW5 (Q1–Q4).
The model was tested on symbolic derivations and conceptual reasoning without code execution.

Accuracy: 9 / 11 one-shot (82 %), 2 / 11 minor-nudge (18 %)

Main errors: one ASCII matrix mis-parse and one BatchNorm vs LayerNorm confusion

No hallucinations: all final answers matched the official HW5 solution key

Takeaway: once prompts were clearly formatted in LaTeX, the model produced correct and interpretable derivations, showing reliable analytical reasoning but high sensitivity to input structure.

Bit slow(90-180 seconds)

(Logs and annotations are attached in the full PDF report.)
